method: local shallow clone source inspection; README-only claims excluded from decision evidence; no benchmark-audit or reproduction performed

behavior_excerpts: pyproject.toml defines console scripts graphify and graphify-mcp plus optional extras for MCP, watch, DB, provider, document, and video support.
__main__.py installs host-specific skills/instructions, exposes extract/query/watch/update/hook/global/benchmark commands, and computes project/global skill destinations per platform.
extract.py uses deterministic extractors, package/MCP manifest ingestion, and safe per-file failure handling that emits warnings instead of aborting the full run.
build.py normalizes source paths and node IDs, remaps legacy semantic IDs, validates extraction data, and deduplicates nodes/edges before graph construction.
serve.py loads graph JSON with file-extension and size-cap checks, then supports query scoring, IDF/trigram candidate lookup, BFS/DFS traversal, and context filtering.
hooks.py installs marked post-commit/post-checkout hooks that locate an importable graphify Python and run rebuild logic with timeout/resource guards.
Tests verify query context filtering, oversized graph rejection, MCP helper scoring/traversal, hook installation idempotence, and extractor ID/edge consistency.
install.sh clones or updates into ~/.understand-anything/repo, symlinks skills into host-specific skill directories, links ~/.understand-anything-plugin, and writes a dynamic Kiro agent config.
Plugin src/index.ts exports chat, diff, explain, onboarding, and context-builder APIs.
scan-project.mjs performs deterministic file enumeration, .understandignore filtering, language/category detection, line counting, and complexity estimation into JSON.

extract-structure.mjs initializes core TreeSitterPlugin and parser registry, reads batch files, emits functions/classes/exports/sections/definitions/call graph data, and degrades per file on failures.
SearchEngine uses Fuse over node name/tags/summary/languageNotes, ORs query tokens, supports type filters, and applies limits.
buildChatContext searches graph nodes, expands one hop through edges, gathers relevant layers, and renders markdown prompt context.
Schema code sanitizes graph fields and aliases common LLM-generated node/edge/complexity/direction variants.
Engine index exports vault compile/query/search/read APIs, MCP server creation, graph tools, memory tasks, retrieval status/rebuild/doctor APIs, hooks, and provider config.
mcp.ts registers workspace, page search, retrieval status/rebuild/doctor, vault doctor, page/source, graph query/report/stats, and other graph/memory tools through the MCP SDK.
vault.ts orchestrates ingestion, analysis, graph construction/enrichment, page generation, search index rebuild, provider calls, memory pages, approvals, and promotion flows.
retrieval.ts computes graph hashes, writes a SQLite retrieval manifest, reports missing/stale graph/index/manifest state, and can rebuild/repair retrieval artifacts.
search.ts uses Node node:sqlite DatabaseSync and FTS5 over generated page title/body, adding source excerpts for source/module pages when manifests point to extracted text.
token-estimation.ts estimates LLM tokens with code/prose char heuristics and drops lower-priority pages to meet a max-token budget.
retrieval.test.ts verifies compile writes retrieval artifacts, search works through the new index path, doctor repairs missing indexes, and migration removes legacy search config.
package.json exposes maestro, maestro-mcp, maestro-statusline, and maestro-context-monitor bins, with workflows/chains/templates/skills included in package files.
cli.ts lazily imports only the requested command module and rejects bare intent text with platform-specific invocation guidance.
mcp/server.ts registers builtin tools via ToolRegistry, filters enabled tools from env/config, runs stdio transport, and starts a delegate channel relay.
GraphFacade detects SQLite, JSON, or no backend; SQLite enables query builder/traverser/manager operations while JSON fallback supports search/path/diff helpers.
context-budget.ts chooses full/reduced/minimal/skip spec injection based on remaining-context bridge metrics, truncating markdown or headings when low.
kg-context-injector.ts extracts prompt symbols/files, queries MaestroGraph for callers/callees/exports, and wraps bounded context up to 3072 chars.
search/daemon.ts keeps a WikiIndexer and embedding index warm behind localhost line-delimited JSON with daemon state and idle shutdown.
prompt-assembler tests cover argument resolution, command building, and previous-result context inclusion.
package.json publishes a Bun-powered @osovv/grace-cli with bin grace and scripts for lint/status validation and marketplace checks.
grace.ts defines a citty CLI with file, lint, module, status, and verification subcommands.
grace-file.ts resolves a governed file from the artifact index and emits JSON or formatted text with optional contracts/blocks.
query/core.ts requires knowledge-graph, development-plan, and verification-plan XML docs; parses modules, graph entries, verifications, plan steps, and governed source files into an index.
findModules scores queries across module metadata, plan/graph purpose, dependencies, verification IDs, interface/annotation tags, file paths, and file purpose/scope.
findVerifications scores verification queries across IDs, module filters, priority, test files, module checks, scenarios, log markers, and trace assertions.
lint/core.ts checks required docs, semantic marker pairing/nesting, ID formats, generic XML anti-patterns, contract fields, language adapters, and verification test reference consistency.
check-references.ts ensures every declared test file is referenced by a module-check command, with cwd-prefix normalization for monorepos.
